g.text: Housing-market figures: Redfin Data Center ZIP-code tracker, all residential, 3 months ending May 2026. ZIP values are apportioned to each ring by area overlap (assumes sales are spread evenly across a ZIP), so they

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #5c6773

g.text: are estimates; the price is a sales-weighted average of ZIP medians, not a true ring median. ZIP areas are Census 2010 ZCTAs; streets: Overture Maps. Population, household and income figures appear only when a

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #5c6773

g.text: demographic extract is supplied (inputs/demographics.csv); none is bundled.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: end; fill: #d1493b
